title: Cal4mity's Tweaks
description: This is a Vanilla enhancement Modpack made for a group of friends.
body:
This is a vanilla enhancement pack that focuses on improving the look of Minecraft, while mechanically leaving the game mostly the same. This pack was primarily made for friends but is open for those who are interested in this specific collection of mods. 
  
  _**NONE** of the mods or resource packs icluded in this Modpack are made by me, and all credit is reserved towards their actual creators._ This is simply my take on a vanilla tweaks modpack that allows for subtle improvements to enhance overall gameplay.

  Using the *Packed Packs* mod, I've included a default resource pack profile called *Cal4mity's Preference*, which simply activates the resource packs I enjoy the most. Feel free to give it a try!
